products.title: Insider Threads X Tank
products.current_description_html:
Breathable Bella+Canvas jersey tank with the lockup on the left chest.

Built for the grind, kept clean. All black with one small Insider Threads lockup: the official Mr. Toasty neon sign over INSIDER THREADS with the thread struck through it, ACTIVE X WEAR underneath. No loud graphics, nothing on the back. Just gear that shows up every day like you do. Insider Threads X Active Wear by Mr. Toasty. Disabled Veteran Owned and Operated. Follow @TherapyToaster on Twitter.
